ATTR-021.determinism: Uses the real default --select-dropdown-exit-animation (dropdownExit 160ms) resolved by Chromium; no private method, no fixed sleeps — observed via public close() + getComputedStyle-derived animation, asserted with expect.poll for removal

ATTR-023.browserTest: ATTR-023: no data-virtual-spacer renders on the public surface for a large list (gap)
ATTR-023.gap: data-virtual-spacer is NOT reachable through the public surface in the current build. The guarded virtualizer that emits spacers (_createGuardedSpacer) is created only inside _ensureGuardedVirtualizer; every entered caller requires _guardedVirtualizer/_guardedVirtualizationRequested to already be established. The only setter of _guardedVirtualizationRequested=true is the private _updateGuardedVirtualWindow, which has NO callers in src; the existing accepted spacer tests (enhanced-select-virtualization-integration.spec.ts, selected-options-virtualization.spec.ts) drive it via the private helper setGuardedWindow -> _updateGuardedVirtualWindow. No public config/method (incl. dataLoading.protocol='acknowledged' + startDataLoading, or virtualize:true) establishes the window. A 2000-item virtualizable list renders options with 0 spacers in real Chromium. NEGATIVE-ONLY coverage recorded: the browser test asserts safe, deterministic absence rather than positive spacer behavior. Remains Diagnostic (private/test-seam reachable only), analogous to PART-009's documented gap; deferred, not forced with a private stub.
negativePaths: 2000-item list with virtualize:true, opened + scrolled -> 0 [data-virtual-spacer] in the open shadow root
